attr.title: Don't Starve (native recompilation)
attr.desc: Don't Starve recompiled from x86 to native ARM64 C: no emulator, no box64. Bring your own DRM-free standalone copy of the game.
attr.inst: Copy bin/dontstarve.exe, data/ and mods/ from your DRM-free standalone install to ports/dontstarve/gamedata/, and msvcr90.dll + msvcp90.dll (VC9 x86 runtime) to ports/dontstarve/crt/. See README.md.
